reuse.why: The MM-DD form is added inside the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate (through a small isHoliday helper), and every holiday check in the tree already goes through that predicate.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated, and holiday matching stays in one function.

placement.why: The change sits in shared/schedules.ts beside the weekend and holiday solving logic.

scope.why: The change is one helper, its use, two tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: isHoliday is small and named and is the single point where holiday entries are interpreted.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Holiday matching goes only through isNonWorkingDay/isHoliday.
